posts.title: Persistence Is the Only Variable That Matters
posts.description: Talent will not. Genius will not. Education will not. Nothing in the world can take the place of persistence. It is the one variable in software - and teams - that consistently predicts outcomes.

posts.title: The Daily Standup Doesn’t Work
posts.description: Most daily standups are status meetings delivered standing up. XP intended a short coordination ritual organized around the work, not the people. They're not the same thing.

posts.title: Sent Does Not Mean Received
posts.description: Sending a message transfers nothing. Responsibility shifts only when you have confirmation it was received and understood. Most team dysfunction lives in the gap between sent and received.
